title: Project Config
description: cvloom.yaml at the project root: settings owned by the project as a whole rather than by one build profile. Named project-config to keep clear of project.json, which types a portfolio project entry.

locale.description: Language the project is written and operated in, e.g. 'en' or 'es'. Selects a pack from cvloom/locales/.

pdf.description: How the rendered PDF is written. Absent means cvloom's default: a tagged PDF declaring no conformance variant.

variant.description: PDF conformance variant to declare. 'pdf/ua-1' is the accessibility standard and the one worth asking for; the pdf/a-* variants are archival. Neither affects how a PDF's text extracts — see docs/reference/ats-readiness.md. Absent means no variant is declared. Every value here passes veraPDF on every shipped template, which is why the list is short: pdf/x-* is print-oriented, pdf/a-4u is written by WeasyPrint with a pdfaid:conformance entry PDF/A-4 forbids, and pdf/a-1b forbids the transparency that cv/timeline-clean and cv/sidebar-compact are drawn with.

ai.description: Which backend and model this project is analysed with. The credential is never expressible here: this file sits at the project root and is committed. Set CVLOOM_AI_API_KEY in the environment instead. Every value here is overridden by the matching CVLOOM_AI_* variable, so a machine can point at its own backend.

base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1. Its absence is what disables AI features.

model.description: Model identifier, e.g. gemma3:27b. Defaults to gpt-4o.
